parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate how the surface of a container affects the rate at which water cools. Two test-tubes, labelled A and B , have been set up for you. Test-tube A has no covering. Test-tube B is covered with foil. Each test-tube has a mark to show the required water level. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1

parts.text: (a) (i) Remove the cork and thermometer from test-tube A . Pour hot water into the test-tube, up to the mark.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Carefully replace the cork and thermometer. Wait for about 30 seconds before taking any measurements.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Start the stopclock and read the thermometer. In the first row of Table 2.1, record this temperature θ at time t = 0 s.

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Record, in the table, the temperature θ of the thermometer at times t = 30 s, 60 s, 90 s,120 s,150 s and 180 s.
